 Judgment

The P.I., of K.R.Puram Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the
accused No.1 to 3 for the offence punishable under sections Secs.498A R/w Sec.34 of Ipc and Secs.3
and

4 of D.P.Act.
2. BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :

It is the case of the complainant that, CW.2 & 3 and accused No.2 and 3 performed the marriage of CW.1 and accused No.1 as per Hindu rites and customs at 'Vinayaka Sabhangana Kalyana Mantapa' at Kolar District in the presence of the elders, at the time of marriage, as per the demand of accused No.2 and 3, CW.2 and 3 gave 5 grams gold chain, cash of Rs.25,000/-, Silver items and 250 grams gold to CW.1 as dowry to the accused No.1 to 3 and performed the marriage by making expenses of Rs.15,00,000/-.

It is further alleged that, the complainant went to her matrimonial house and led marital life with accused No.1 to 3 at house Flat No.5, Savaria Levinestan Apartment, H.V.R Layout, Medihalli, K.R.pura, after three months,
accused No.1 to 3 with a common intention demanded 25 Lakhs as dowry from the C.C.No.51090/2022 parents of CW.1 and subjected her to cruelty by harassing her both physically and mentally.

It is further alleged that, accused No.1 to 3 abused CW.1 in filthy language, assaulted her and behaved badly with her, on 09.02.2021 accused No.1 to 3 thrown CW.1 from marital house and subjected her to cruelty both by physically and mentally for dowry.

Based on the written complaint lodged by C.W.1,
CW.11 has registered the case against accused No.1 to 3 in P.S. Crime No.309/2021 Sushma M vs Vishwas B.E on 4 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190274232/
2 for the offence punishable under sections 498(a) R/w 34 of IPC and sections.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the above mentioned offence alleged against the accused No.1 to 3 and registered the criminal case against them.
4. After registering the case, the accused No.1 to 3 have appeared before this court and enlarged on bail.
Copies of the final report and it's enclosures were furnished to them in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were C.C.No.51090/2022 made out to frame charges.

Hence,
charges framed and read over to the accused No.1 to 3 only.
They pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

5. In order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 12 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.5 and closed its side.
In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused No.1 to 3, recording of their statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
6. Heard both sides.
Perused the materials on record.
Whether the prosecution proves beyond all have demanded cash of Rs.25 Lakhs from CW.1 and subjected her to cruelty and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act ?
3. What Order?

8. My findings on the above points are as under:
 Point Nos.1 & 2 : In the Negative.
 Point No.3 : As per the final order  for the following;
 REASONS  9. POINT Nos.1 and 2 :-

3
As these two points are interlinked, I have taken up these points together for common discussion to avoid repetition of facts & evidence.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3, the prosecution has examined the complainant/victim/C.W.1 as P.W.1 and relied upon five documents.

10. In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3, the prosecution has examined the complainant / C.C.No.51090/2022 victim CW.1 as PW.1, wherein, the said witness has not supported the case of the prosecution.

The learned APP appearing for the State with permission treated the said witness as hostile and fully cross examined her, wherein, nothing has been elicited from the mouth of the PW.1 in order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3.
11.

On perusal of the materials on record and the oral & documentary evidence of P.W.1, she has categorically admitted that, she has got divorced from accused No.1 and got compromised the matter with the accused Nos.1 to 3.

In view of the evidence of P.W.1, since the matter was compromised, the prayer of the learned Senior Asst. Public Prosecutor for issuance of witness summons to other witnesses was rejected as no purpose would be served.
As the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused No.1 to 3.

Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused No.1 to 3 and hence,
the Point Nos.1 and 2 are answered in the "Negative".

12. Point No.3 :- In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
C.C.No.51090/2022 ORDER Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 to 3 are acquitted of the offence punishable under Secs.498A R/w Sec.34 of IPC and Secs.3 and 4 of D.P.Act.
The bail bonds of the accused No.1 to 3 shall be in force for the period of 6 months and thereafter it shall be cancelled without further orders.
